name: create-starter
description: Scaffold projects from the Starter Series templates — MCP server, Claude Code skill, and CLI.
long_description: Downloads a Starter Series template (Discord bot, Telegram bot, Docker deploy, MCP server, and more), substitutes placeholders, handles Python package renames, and runs git init. Input is Zod-validated, extraction is atomic via sibling tmp directory, and downloads have retry/timeout/size limits.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List all available Starter Series project templates

tools.description: Scaffold a new project from a Starter Series template
